testName: DreamHouse: Property Listing Filtering by Price Slider & Bedrooms
steps:
1. Open DreamHouse App from App Launcher
2. Navigate to "Properties" Explorer tab
3. Locate "Property Filters" sidebar component
4. Drag Price Range slider minimum to "$600,000" and maximum to "$1,200,000"
5. Select Bedrooms picklist "3+"
6. Verify property card grid dynamically refreshes without page reload
7. Verify all displayed property cards have Price between $600k and $1.2M and at least 3 bedrooms
8. Click on first property card "Victorian Modern Retreat" to open details
